hwInfo[0]: the index in the burst buffer where the trailing LOD-bias words go (record[recordIndex] = 0x50b; recordIndex + 2 is the dword count)
binding slot number: 0x10, or 0x20 for the last texture of the list (slot*4 is the table offset)
this+0x298 (set_surface's unknown_0x298 argument), 0 in the other arm: the weight multiplying (offset[nextMipLevel] - offset[mipLevel]) in the LOD-bias word and in the per-attachment addresses
mipLevel + 1: the second per-level offset of the interpolation (1 in the other arm)
